rule: Sovereign IQ platform playbook (PLAN S7, WS-S3). Service-level entries for AWS, Azure and Google Cloud; approach-level entries for every other platform (D17). Service families, not product lists (D19); each option is sourced in the claims register with a 90-day review (D8). Technical controls need an entry on every platform that holds the affected data; process controls (transfer register, sub-processors, exit plan) use one 'any' entry.
